forward_guidance.text: The Company expects supply constraints and increasing costs for components to intensify, which may materially adversely affect demand for the Company’s products and negatively impact the Company’s revenue, costs, gross margin, results of operations and financial condition.

key_risks.description: Supply constraints and increasing costs for components, including advanced semiconductors, storage (NAND) and memory (DRAM), may materially adversely affect demand for the Company’s products and negatively impact the Company’s revenue, costs, gross margin, results of operations and financial condition.
